sentences.text: Adam Mitchel Lambert -LRB- born January 29 , 1982 -RRB- is an American singer , songwriter and stage actor .
Since 2009 , he has sold over 3 million albums and 5 million singles worldwide .
Lambert rose to fame in 2009 after finishing as runner-up on the eighth season of American Idol .	eighth season	American Idol (season 8)	American Idol	American Idol
Later that year , he released his debut album , For Your Entertainment , which debuted at number three on the U.S. Billboard 200 .	For Your Entertainment	For Your Entertainment (album)

The album spawned several hit singles , including `` Whataya Want from Me '' , for which he received a Grammy nomination for `` Best Male Pop Vocal Performance '' .	Pop	Pop music	Whataya Want from Me	Whataya Want from Me
In 2012 , Lambert released his second studio album , Trespassing .	Trespassing	Trespassing (album)
The album premiered at number one on the U.S. Billboard 200 , making him the first openly gay artist to top the album charts .
In 2015 , Lambert released his third album , The Original High , which debuted at number three on the U.S. Billboard 200 .	The Original High	The Original High

Alongside his solo career , Lambert has collaborated with rock band Queen as lead vocalist for Queen + Adam Lambert since 2011 , culminating in a successful world-wide tour from 2014 to 2016 .	Queen	Queen (band)	Queen + Adam Lambert	Queen + Adam Lambert
